Changed [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs) to add a default-off ANN prescore mode, `VDB_QUANTIZED_PRESCORE_MODE=primary_residual`, and wired it through the local ANN wrappers in [.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only), [.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark), [.meta_codex/tools/sweep_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/sweep_ann_search_only), and [.meta_codex/tools/sweep_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/sweep_ann_benchmark). The first version had a cross-primary scoring bug; I fixed it by using shared residual scales across primaries. I also updated the persistent campaign docs and added [.meta_codex/recent_cycles/cycle_053.json](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/recent_cycles/cycle_053.json).

Result: the new branch is locally real but not exact-promotable yet. Best local no-radius point was `14 / 144 / 416` at about `5896.86 QPS`, `0.9507` recall with `primary_residual`, versus about `5521.19`, `0.9503` in global mode. But the exact fast gate parked it: `200` queries came in about `4888.18 QPS`, `0.9690`, and `1000` queries about `4877.22`, `0.9557`, still below the kept flat exact band. The default scored path ended clean: `build_project` succeeded, `run_correctness_test` passed at `1.0000`, and `run_benchmark` reached `12334.96 QPS`.

Current score expectation is still local low-`12k` quick on the official scored path, with ANN exact still roughly high-`4k`/low-`5k`. Next best move is to keep the residual prescore branch but make it compatible with reusable lower bounds, likely by encoding secondary centroids and radius metadata in the same residual space before spending another exact gate.
